blockers.title: The new share error, and the save confirmation, appear under the fixed bottom navigation, so the owner's complaint 'the error is easy to miss' still reproduces
blockers.evidence: src/features/settings/CourseFiles.tsx:334-340 renders ErrorNotice and the shareMessage status below the Salva file / Condividi grid. Nothing scrolls them into view, and they get no space above the fixed nav. The styles.css scroll-margin-bottom only protects the focused element. Measured with the throwaway spec (my scratchpad's r6/r6.spec.ts), Prepara il file del corso scrolled to sit just above the nav (the point where one thumb stops scrolling as soon as the button shows). Pixel 7 at 412 px and default text: after Prepara, focus scroll leaves Salva file at 715-759 and Condividi at 767-811, with the nav top at 764, so Condividi is already under the bar. After Salva file, 'Salvataggio avviato…' renders at 819-859 (under the nav). After Condividi, the alert 'Condivisione non riuscita. Puoi salvare il file con Salva file.' renders at 767-807 (fully under the nav). iPhone 13 WebKit at 390 px: the alert is at 592-632 with the nav top at 589, so it is entirely under the bar. In test-results/field-ux-r6/iphone-13-webkit-device-4-share-error.png it shows only as a ghost through the translucent bar. Pixel 7 at 320 px and 200% text: the alert spans 404-564 with the nav top at 490, so only 'Condivisione non riuscita. Puoi' is visible (pixel-7-chrome-320-200-4-share-error.png). role=alert does announce it to a screen reader. A sighted user sees no reaction to the tap, which is exactly the 'Condivisione non riuscita whose text was easy to miss' and 'seemed to work silently' in .evidence/D4/physical-device-review.json.
blockers.reproduction: Playwright, pixel-7-chrome or iPhone 13 WebKit project, navigator.share mocked to reject with NotAllowedError. 1) Create a Deriva Livello 2 course. 2) Home > Impostazioni. 3) Scroll until Prepara il file del corso sits just above the bottom bar, then tap it. 4) Tap Salva file. Expected: a visible confirmation. Observed: the status renders under the bar. 5) Tap Condividi. Expected: an error with a triangle that can be seen without scrolling (R06, R12, R14). Observed: the alert's bounding box is behind the fixed nav (hiddenUnderNav=true in pixel-7-chrome-device.json and iphone-13-webkit-device.json in test-results/field-ux-r6/). When Prepara starts mid-screen the feedback fits, so the defect depends on scroll position, but the bottom position is the one the one-thumb rule pushes users towards.
blockers.specRef: docs/design/06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R12 (sticky/floating elements must not cover elements), R06/R14 and the Avviso row; owner CHANGES_REQUESTED item in .evidence/D4/physical-device-review.json (D4 evidence requires the owner's phone check)

importantFindings.title: At 320 px and 200% text, moving focus to Salva file jumps the page about 495 px and scrolls the check icon and 'File del corso pronto' off the top
importantFindings.evidence: CourseFiles.tsx:118-122 calls saveButton.current?.focus() without preventScroll and without bringing the status into view. Chromium and WebKit centre the focused button's scroll-margin box. Pixel 7 at 320/200%: scrollY goes from 1546 to 2040 after one tap. The status paragraph ends up at top -100 / bottom 180, offscreen=true, so the CircleCheck icon and the words 'File del corso pronto:' are above the viewport. The user lands mid-sentence on 'salvalo o condividilo. Il nome non contiene dati personali.' iPhone 13 WebKit is the same (scrollY 1505 to 2000, status top -100). At device width and default text the jump is only 45 px (Pixel) or 65 px (iPhone), and the status stays visible.
importantFindings.reproduction: test-results/field-ux-r6/pixel-7-chrome-320-200-1-before-prepare.png against -2-after-prepare.png. The JSON next to them records 'before' and 'after' scrollY. Suggested direction: keep the status and both buttons in view together (for example, scroll the status's container into view with block 'start' clear of the nav), or give Salva file aria-describedby pointing to the status.
importantFindings.specRef: docs/design/06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R05/R18 (200% text, no loss of content), R12 (focus return)

importantFindings.title: Screen-reader confirmation of the prepared file is not guaranteed: a status region inserted already populated and immediately followed by a focus move
importantFindings.evidence:
CourseFiles.tsx:292-304 mounts a new

with its text in the same render that replaces the Prepara button, and the effect at :118-122 then moves focus to Salva file. Many screen readers do not announce a live region inserted already populated, and the focus announcement 'Salva file, pulsante' can preempt a polite region. The ARIA snapshot shows the status present, but nothing ties it to the focused button. Not verified with TalkBack or VoiceOver.
importantFindings.reproduction: Read the code; ariaSnapshot in test-results/field-ux-r6/*-device.json. A low-cost hardening is aria-describedby on Salva file pointing at the status text.

qolFindings.title: The shared copy is a .txt while the saved copy is a .json; the screen does not say so
qolFindings.evidence: The share mock received name cvc-helper-corso-2026-W43.txt with type text/plain. The download is cvc-helper-corso-2026-W43.json. Import accepts both (accept='.json,.txt,application/json,text/plain', CourseFiles.tsx:356). A tired instructor who finds two files with different extensions in the chat and in Download may wonder which one is real. One line of copy would settle it.

qolFindings.title: The 'cancellazione riprenderà' promise is unconditional, but the resume needs localStorage
qolFindings.evidence: localDataOperations.ts setResetPending swallows storage failures ('it just cannot resume'), while App.tsx:895 always promises a resume. It is truthful in every normal browser I exercised. Wording such as 'di norma riprenderà' is not needed unless storage-less contexts matter.

Node v24.21.0. My own Playwright run used a throwaway config and spec in my scratchpad's r6/, with its own Vite server on port 4191, on Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 13 (WebKit): 6/6 passed, about 1 minute. The share mock rejects with NotAllowedError, and the import test uses an invalid .txt file.

Measured: the export two-step (the Chiudi button is gone, the status has a CircleCheck and font-weight 600, focus lands on 'Salva file' with :focus-visible false, so no stray ring on touch). Error and status contrast against the white card: error text #a2381b at 6.74:1, triangle icon at 6.57:1, ready status at 6.43:1, muted status at 5.89:1, all at least 4.5:1. The error is role=alert, the SVG is aria-hidden=true, and the triangle plus bold text means colour is not the only cue. scrollWidth equals clientWidth at 320/200%. Element positions relative to the fixed nav.

Reset wording: deletion stubbed to hang, then the page closed and reopened. On reopen the first heading is 'Cancellazione dei dati locali…', not 'Apertura del corso…'. The reset completes in 0.8 s on Pixel and 2.3-2.7 s on WebKit, followed by 'Dati locali cancellati' and Riapri l'app, which leads to Crea il corso. Text at 320/200% fits (scrollWidth 320). The wording is truthful in the exercised paths.
